theorem lg_target {τ : ℂ} (hτ : 0 < τ.im) (n : ℤ) : ‖Complex.exp (↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs := by
  rw [Complex.norm_exp, Real.exp_real]
  have h : Real.exp (-π * ↑n ^ 2 * τ.im) ≤ Real.exp (-π * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs :=
    by
      cases n with k hk
      · exact le_rfl
      · have h1 : ↑k ^ 2 ≥ ↑k := by simp only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_id, Nat.cast_nonneg]
        have h2 : ↑k ^ 2 ≤ ↑k.natAbs := by simp only [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_id, Nat.cast_nonneg]
        rw [Real.exp_le_exp_iff, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_mul]
        exact le_trans h1 h2
        exact Real.exp_le_exp (le_rfl)
  exact h
